name: Ueno Seiyoken
accessSummary: 5 min walk from JR Ueno Station Park Exit / 5 min walk from Keisei Ueno Station Main Exit / 5 min walk from Tokyo Metro Ueno Station Exit 7 / 8 min walk from Toei Ueno-okachimachi Station Exit A3
notice: Banquet reservations are accepted from 1 year in advance. Banquet and meeting plans run for 2 hours, and the menu must be confirmed by 5 days before. Prices include tax and exclude the 10% service charge. Free Wi-Fi is available at the venue. Video equipment such as screens and projectors, and microphones, are provided for a fee.

ops.parking: There is a private parking lot with 39 spaces, right in front of the main restaurant building. It may be unavailable on some days, for example when full. If you are coming by chartered bus, contact the person in charge in advance (without prior contact, you may not be able to park depending on the situation on the day). To reach the private parking lot, go from Dobutsuen-dori along the road beside Gojo Tenjinsha Shrine.
ops.restaurants: The main building houses the restaurant "Honten Grill" (3 private rooms). It is open for lunch 11:00-15:00 (until 16:00 on Sat, Sun & holidays) and dinner 17:00-21:00 (dinner by reservation only), and is closed on Mondays (open if Monday is a holiday). The Premium Party Plan, which reserves the whole floor, is for 25 to 60 people, 2-hour exclusive use (17:30-21:00, with 90 minutes of free-flow drinks).
